# Learner event catalogue

Every learner interaction Kuizi records, as a versioned Avro event on the Kafka API (T023, [ADR 0010](../architecture/decisions/0010-learner-event-contracts.md)). This page is generated from [`schemas/events/catalogue.yaml`](../../schemas/events/catalogue.yaml) and the schemas next to it: change those, then run `make schemas-docs`. How to add or change an event: [`schemas/README.md`](../../schemas/README.md).

## Conventions

| Topic | Rule |
| --- | --- |
| Format | Avro. One record per event; shared types in `schemas/events/common/` are inlined, so each registered schema is self-contained. |
| Topics | `learner.<event>.v<major>`, one topic per event. A breaking change needs a new major (a new topic and subject) and a migration period. |
| Registry subjects | `<topic>-value` (topic name strategy). Compatibility **BACKWARD_TRANSITIVE** on every subject, checked offline before merge and enforced by the registry. |
| Kafka key | `envelope.student_id` as a plain UTF-8 string, so one learner's events stay in order in each topic. |
| De-duplication | `envelope.event_id`, a UUID (v7 recommended) created when the event happens; retries and offline replays reuse it. |
| Timestamps | UTC milliseconds since the epoch (`timestamp-millis`). `client_ts` is the device clock (used for elapsed and lag time), `server_ts` is set by Kuizi. |
| Identifiers | Pseudonymous UUIDs only. No name, email, phone number, national ID, IP address, device identifier, location, raw keystroke or free text. |
| Enums | First symbol `UNKNOWN`, which is also the enum default, so new values never break older readers. |
| Optional fields | `["null", T]` with default `null`. Every field added later must have a default. |
| Steward | The data-engineering agent reviews every change; changing an event that other services read needs the product owner, and a new personal or sensitive field also needs the DPO. |

## Privacy classes

Every field carries a `privacy` label in its schema. Rule followed: Law 2004-63 on personal data, with the minors' rules of E02 and the data-protection section of docs/requirements/accessibility-focus-notifications.md (section 3). Accommodation data is sensitive.

| Class | Meaning | Who may read | Handling |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **none** | Technical or curriculum value that says nothing about the learner, even next to the student ID (event IDs, item and concept IDs, versions). | Any service or analyst with telemetry access. | No restriction beyond the event's retention. |
| **pseudonymous** | Identifier that points to a learner, a group of learners or one of their sessions, conversations or notifications only through another Kuizi store. | Services that join or de-duplicate events; analysts only in hashed form. | Kept in raw telemetry; replaced by a salted hash or dropped in analytics exports; erased with the learner (T018). |
| **personal** | What a pseudonymous learner did, answered or uses (answers, timings, confidence, device class, language). | Learning services (knowledge tracing, routing, gamification, notifications) and the analytics warehouse. | Aggregated in exports and dashboards (no small groups); erased with the learner (T018); raw rows purged after the event's retention. |
| **sensitive** | May reveal a disability or health need (accommodations). Sensitive health-related data under Law 2004-63. | Only the services listed in the event's sensitive_readers, and the learner's own data export (T018). | Sent only with the separate accommodation consent (T013, T151); masked by default in the warehouse (T217) with every read audited (T022); never in leaderboards, analytics exports, parent summaries, teacher views (unless the learner shares the flag through the comfort profile, T146) or LLM prompts; cleared when accommodation consent is withdrawn (T151). |

Sensitive fields may only live in `AccommodationContext`; `make schemas-check` rejects a sensitive field anywhere else. Field names that invite personal data are rejected too: `address`, `advertising_id`, `age`, `audio`, `birth_date`, `body`, `cin`, `city`, `content`, `date_of_birth`, `device_id`, `display_name`, `email`, `first_name`, `full_name`, `gender`, `geo`, `ip`, `ip_address`, `key`, `key_code`, `keys`, `last_name`, `latitude`, `location`, `login`, `longitude`, `message_text`, `mobile`, `msisdn`, `name`, `national_id`, `passport`, `phone`, `phone_number`, `photo`, `surname`, `text`, `transcript`, `typed_text`, `user_agent`, `username`.

## Knowledge-tracing inputs (for the ML sign-off)

What the knowledge-tracing models (ADR 0007: AKT proposed, DKT fallback, SAINT+ re-tested in T239) and the accommodation-aware work (T148) consume, and the event field that carries each input. Field references are checked against the schemas by `make schemas-check`.

**Known** says when an input exists. Inputs known only after the answer feed the predictions of later attempts, never the prediction of the attempt they come from (shifted one step), so the label never leaks.

Reviewed by the ML Engineering agent: [ML review of the event schemas](event-schema-ml-review.md) (signed off with conditions, including rules for the tickets that build these features).

| Model input | Models | Event fields | Known | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Learner sequence and order | DKT, AKT, SAINT+, IRT | `item.answered:envelope.student_id`<br>`item.answered:envelope.client_ts`<br>`item.answered:envelope.session_seq` | At presentation | Kafka key is student_id, so one learner's answers stay in order in the topic. Sequences sort by client_ts, then session_seq (required on item.answered), then server_ts; T048 inserts each answer by this key, not by Kafka offset, because offline answers arrive late. |
| Question (exercise) ID | AKT, SAINT+, IRT | `item.answered:item.item_id`<br>`item.answered:item.item_version` | At presentation | AKT learns one Rasch difficulty per item, SAINT+ an item embedding, IRT a and b per item. The version separates edited items. |
| Concepts (knowledge components) | DKT, AKT, SAINT+, BKT | `item.answered:item.kc_ids` | At presentation | Primary concept first; tag weights are joined from the item bank (T036). The T041 adapter expands multi-concept items. |
| Correctness label and partial credit | DKT, AKT, SAINT+, BKT, IRT | `item.answered:correct`<br>`item.answered:score` | After the answer (one step later) | The label of every model, metric and the T047 gate is correct (full credit) on attempt 1. score, from 0 to 1, carries partial credit (T221) and is an input for later steps (wrong, partial, right), never the label. |
| Elapsed time | SAINT+, AKT time experiment (T042) | `item.answered:latency_ms`<br>`item.answered:active_ms` | After the answer (one step later) | Use active_ms (time in the foreground), falling back to latency_ms when null, capped at 600 s. Known only after the answer, so it enters the model one step later. |
| Lag time | SAINT+, AKT time experiment (T042) | `item.answered:presented_client_ts`<br>`item.answered:envelope.client_ts` | At presentation | lag(i) = presented_client_ts(i) minus the latest envelope.client_ts among the learner's item.answered events with client_ts at or before presented_client_ts(i), any attempt and any activity. Computed before the training filters (attempt 1, activity). Null for the learner's first item; negative values (clock skew) are clamped to 0. Device clocks only, never server_ts. T028 and T048 share one implementation of this definition. |
| Hints used and hint level | SAINT+ decoder (T042), DKT features (T070) | `item.answered:hints_used`<br>`item.answered:max_hint_level`<br>`hint.requested:level`<br>`hint.shown:level` | After the answer (one step later) | Counted before each attempt, per presentation, tutor hints included. Shifted one step like elapsed time: the hints used before attempt i never feed the prediction of attempt i, because hint use strongly predicts failure and would leak the label. |
| Attempt number | DKT, AKT, SAINT+ | `item.answered:attempt` | At presentation | Training keeps attempt 1 by default, like ASSISTments, whose correct is first-attempt correctness (original == 1 removes scaffolding sub-problems, not retries). Later attempts are inputs, never targets. |
| Confidence 1 to 5 | SAINT+ decoder (T042) | `item.answered:confidence_1_5` | After the answer (one step later) | Given after answering; null when not asked, so models need a missing value. Shifted one step like elapsed time, so the label does not leak. |
| Time multiplier (normalisation) | Accommodation-aware tracing (T148) | `item.answered:accommodation.time_multiplier`<br>`item.answered:accommodation.untimed` | At presentation | Sensitive. The multiplier applied to this item's timers; T148 uses it to normalise in-item time features (whether lag time is normalised too waits for the product owner, ML review question 4). A null accommodation means 1.0. |
| Assistive-mode embedding | Accommodation-aware tracing (T148) | `item.answered:accommodation.assistive_modes` | At presentation | Sensitive. Empty list or null accommodation means no assistive technology. |
| Listening time apart from thinking time | Accommodation-aware tracing (T148) | `item.answered:audio_playback_ms`<br>`tts.played:played_ms` | After the answer (one step later) | Kuizi's own audio on the item before the answer. Screen-reader speech is invisible to Kuizi. |
| Timed out | AKT, SAINT+ | `item.answered:timed_out` | After the answer (one step later) | Lets training drop or flag forced submissions. |
| Activity (placement, practice, review, mock Bac) | IRT cold start (T043), all models as a filter | `item.answered:item.activity` | At presentation | Placement answers seed the IRT estimate; mock-Bac answers can be weighted apart. |
| Subject and Bac section | All models (T033) | `item.answered:item.subject_id`<br>`item.answered:item.track_id` | At presentation | Filled once T033 lands. |
| Item language variant | Candidate feature | `item.answered:item.item_language` | At presentation | French and Arabic variants of an item may differ in difficulty. |
| Misconception code | Misconception diagnosis (T071), candidate feature | `item.answered:misconception_code` | After the answer (one step later) | From the answer evaluation service (T221). |
| Hesitation and time to first action | Candidate features (T042, gated by T047) | `item.answered:first_action_ms`<br>`item.hesitation:idle_ms`<br>`item.hesitation:before_first_action` | After the answer (one step later) | No hesitation is emitted while Kuizi audio plays (T148). |
| Interaction trace in simulations | Misconception diagnosis (T071) | `item.interaction:kind`<br>`item.interaction:value_from`<br>`item.interaction:value_to` | After the answer (one step later) | One event per gesture. |
| Session and Focus context | Feature store (T030), send-time model (T154) | `session.start:envelope.session_id`<br>`session.end:duration_ms`<br>`focus.end:reason` | At presentation | Session count and study windows, from earlier sessions. |

## Event details

### focus.end

A Focus session ended, completed or stopped early (stopping early carries no penalty, FR-F5).

- **Topic** `learner.focus.end.v1` · **subject** `learner.focus.end.v1-value` · **record** `kuizi.events.FocusEnd`
- **Owner** frontend · **producer** Web and native apps (Focus mode), through the telemetry SDK and ingestion (T155, T024, T025, app event)
- **Envelope fields that must be filled** `client_ts`, `session_id`, `session_seq`, `focus_session_id`, `device`, `app_version`
- **Retention** 7 days in Kafka, 24 months raw in the warehouse · **highest class** personal
- **Example** [`schemas/events/examples/focus.end.json`](../../schemas/events/examples/focus.end.json)

Consumers (plus the [consumers of every event](#consumers-of-every-event)):

| Service | Tickets | Uses |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Real-time aggregation (Focus state in Redis) | T026 | Clears the Focus state. |
| Send-time model | T154 | Completed sessions per time of day. |
| Product analytics | T191 | Completion rate of Focus sessions. |

| Field | Type | Default | Class | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `envelope` | [Envelope](#envelope) | required | personal | Shared event context; focus_session_id is the session that ended. |
| `planned_minutes` | int | required | personal | Length chosen at focus.start. |
| `duration_ms` | long | required | personal | Milliseconds from focus.start to the end. |
| `reason` | [FocusEndReason](#enums) | `"UNKNOWN"` | personal | COMPLETED at the planned time, STOPPED_EARLY by the learner, INTERRUPTED by an essential notification or the device, APP_CLOSED. |
| `items_answered` | int | `0` | personal | Number of item.answered events during the Focus session. |
| `break_prompted` | boolean | `false` | personal | True when the app offered a break at the end (FR-F4). |

### focus.start

The learner started a Focus session (FR-F1, FR-F6, T155). envelope.focus_session_id is the new Focus session's ID; every event until focus.end carries it.

- **Topic** `learner.focus.start.v1` · **subject** `learner.focus.start.v1-value` · **record** `kuizi.events.FocusStart`
- **Owner** frontend · **producer** Web and native apps (Focus mode), through the telemetry SDK and ingestion (T155, T024, T025, app event)
- **Envelope fields that must be filled** `client_ts`, `session_id`, `session_seq`, `focus_session_id`, `device`, `app_version`
- **Retention** 7 days in Kafka, 24 months raw in the warehouse · **highest class** personal
- **Example** [`schemas/events/examples/focus.start.json`](../../schemas/events/examples/focus.start.json)

Consumers (plus the [consumers of every event](#consumers-of-every-event)):

| Service | Tickets | Uses |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Real-time aggregation (Focus state in Redis) | T026 | Marks the learner as in Focus until focus.end or the planned end. |
| Notification Orchestrator | T152 | Defers non-essential messages during Focus (FR-F2, FR-N3), through the Focus state. |
| Send-time model | T154 | Focus sessions as study-window signal. |
| Product analytics | T191 | Feature use. |

| Field | Type | Default | Class | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `envelope` | [Envelope](#envelope) | required | personal | Shared event context. |
| `planned_minutes` | int | required | personal | Length chosen: 15, 25 or 45 minutes (FR-F1). |
| `source` | [FocusSource](#enums) | `"UNKNOWN"` | personal | From the daily plan, from an exercise, or OS_FOCUS when Kuizi follows a Focus started on the device (FR-F3). |
| `device_focus_enabled` | boolean | `false` | personal | True when the device's own Focus or Do Not Disturb was switched on for the session (FR-F3, T156). |

### hint.requested

A hint was asked for on an item, by the learner, by a hint timer (scaled by the time multiplier, T070) or by the tutor.

- **Topic** `learner.hint.requested.v1` · **subject** `learner.hint.requested.v1-value` · **record** `kuizi.events.HintRequested`
- **Owner** frontend · **producer** Web and native apps (hint ladder), through the telemetry SDK and ingestion (T070, T024, T025, app event)
- **Envelope fields that must be filled** `client_ts`, `session_id`, `session_seq`, `device`, `app_version`
- **Retention** 7 days in Kafka, 24 months raw in the warehouse · **highest class** personal
- **Example** [`schemas/events/examples/hint.requested.json`](../../schemas/events/examples/hint.requested.json)

Consumers (plus the [consumers of every event](#consumers-of-every-event)):

| Service | Tickets | Uses |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Learning-analytics warehouse models | T028 | Hint dependency per learner and item. |
| Feature store | T030 | Hint dependency ratio. |
| Hint ladder | T070 | Which levels are requested, by trigger, before and after attempts. |

| Field | Type | Default | Class | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `envelope` | [Envelope](#envelope) | required | personal | Shared event context. |
| `item` | [ItemContext](#itemcontext) | required | personal | The item and its presentation_id. |
| `level` | int | required | personal | Hint level asked for: 1 Socratic question, 2 conceptual nudge, 3 worked step, 4 full solution (T070). |
| `trigger` | [HintTrigger](#enums) | `"UNKNOWN"` | personal | STUDENT pressed the hint button, TIMER is time-based escalation, TUTOR is the Socratic tutor offering one. |
| `offset_ms` | long | required | personal | Milliseconds between the presentation of the item and the request. |
| `attempts_before` | int | `0` | personal | Answers already submitted in this presentation (level 4 needs at least 2, T070). |

- **Owner** frontend · **producer** Web and native apps (hint ladder), through the telemetry SDK and ingestion (T070, T024, T025, app event)
- **Envelope fields that must be filled** `client_ts`, `session_id`, `session_seq`, `device`, `app_version`
- **Retention** 7 days in Kafka, 24 months raw in the warehouse · **highest class** personal

Consumers (plus the [consumers of every event](#consumers-of-every-event)):

| Service | Tickets | Uses |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Learning-analytics warehouse models and training sequences | T028, T042 | Hint level as a knowledge-tracing feature (T070 acceptance criterion). |
| Hint feedback | T072 | Joins ratings and 'this is wrong' reports to the hint shown. |

| Field | Type | Default | Class | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `envelope` | [Envelope](#envelope) | required | personal | Shared event context. |
| `item` | [ItemContext](#itemcontext) | required | personal | The item and its presentation_id. |

| `level` | int | required | personal | Level of the hint shown, 1 to 4 (T070). |
| `source` | [HintSource](#enums) | `"UNKNOWN"` | none | ITEM_BANK for authored hints, TUTOR for hints written by the Socratic tutor and passed by the judge (T062). |

### item.answered

One submitted answer to an item, graded on the server by the answer evaluation service (T221). One event per attempt. It is self-sufficient for knowledge tracing: item, concepts, correctness, timings, hints, attempt and confidence are all here, so the online sequence builder (T048) and the training sequences (T028) need no join.

- **Topic** `learner.item.answered.v1` · **subject** `learner.item.answered.v1-value` · **record** `kuizi.events.ItemAnswered`
- **Owner** backend · **producer** Answer evaluation service (client fields come from the app's submit request) (T221, server event)
- **Envelope fields that must be filled** `client_ts`, `session_id`, `session_seq`, `device`, `app_version`
- **Retention** 7 days in Kafka, 24 months raw in the warehouse · **highest class** sensitive
- **Example** [`schemas/events/examples/item.answered.json`](../../schemas/events/examples/item.answered.json)

Consumers (plus the [consumers of every event](#consumers-of-every-event)):

| Service | Tickets | Uses |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Real-time aggregation (streaks, XP, daily goal) | T026, T087 | correct, score and envelope timestamps; must ignore accommodation. |
| Learning-analytics warehouse models and training sequences | T028, T041 | fct_attempts and ml_training_sequences (one row per attempt, ordered per learner). |
| Feature store | T030 | Rolling accuracy per concept, mean latency, hint dependency ratio. |
| Misconception diagnosis | T071 | response and misconception_code. |
| Experimentation framework | T055 | Learning-gain metrics. |
| Product analytics | T191 | Activation and feature use, without sensitive fields. |

Allowed to read the sensitive fields (nobody else may read or store them):

| Service | Tickets | Uses |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Online sequence builder | T048, T148 | accommodation.* for accommodation-aware inference; its cold rebuild from the warehouse also goes through the restricted role. |
| Knowledge-tracing training, through the restricted warehouse role | T041, T042, T148, T239, T045 | Time features divided by time_multiplier; assistive-mode embedding. |
| Champion/challenger gate | T047 | Fairness slices by accommodation type (aggregates only). |

| Field | Type | Default | Class | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `envelope` | [Envelope](#envelope) | required | personal | Shared event context. client_ts is the moment the learner submitted, sent by the app with the answer. |
| `item` | [ItemContext](#itemcontext) | required | personal | The item answered and its presentation_id. |
| `accommodation` | [AccommodationContext](#accommodationcontext) or null | `null` | sensitive | Accommodations in force for this attempt; null when none or not consented. Sensitive: restricted readers only. |
| `attempt` | int | required | personal | 1-based number of this submission within the presentation. Knowledge tracing uses attempt 1 by default. |
| `presented_client_ts` | timestamp-millis | required | personal | When the item was presented, by the device clock (equals envelope.client_ts of item.presented). Lag time is derived from it; the exact definition is in the data catalogue (knowledge-tracing inputs). |
| `latency_ms` | long | required | personal | Milliseconds from the presentation of the item to this submission, by the device clock. The elapsed-time feature of knowledge tracing. |
| `active_ms` | long or null | `null` | personal | Part of latency_ms during which the item was on screen with the app in the foreground. |
| `first_action_ms` | long or null | `null` | personal | Milliseconds from the presentation to the learner's first gesture on the item (time to first click, T024); null if the learner answered without any recorded gesture. |
| `audio_playback_ms` | long | `0` | personal | Milliseconds of Kuizi audio (read-aloud, sonified simulation) played on this item before the submission. Lets models separate listening time from thinking time (T148). |
| `hints_used` | int | `0` | personal | Number of hints shown in this presentation before the submission. |
| `max_hint_level` | int or null | `null` | personal | Highest hint level shown before the submission (1 question, 2 nudge, 3 worked step, 4 solution; T070); null when no hint was shown. |
| `response` | [Response](#response) | required | personal | The learner's answer. |
| `correct` | boolean | required | personal | True when the answer earns full credit. The correctness label of knowledge tracing. |
| `score` | double | required | personal | Credit earned, from 0.0 to 1.0: partial credit for multi-step and widget items (T221), 0 or 1 for the others. |
| `misconception_code` | string or null | `null` | personal | Misconception diagnosed from a wrong answer (T071, T221), as a code from the curriculum team's taxonomy; null when none. |
| `confidence_1_5` | int or null | `null` | personal | Confidence the learner gave before seeing the result, from 1 (guessing) to 5 (sure); null when not asked. |
| `timed_out` | boolean | `false` | personal | True when the submission was forced because the item's time ran out. |
| `grader_version` | string or null | `null` | none | Version of the answer evaluation service that graded the answer (T221), for re-grading and audits. |

#### Response

What the learner answered, in the shape of the item type (T036). Only answer-field input; tutor chat text is never here.

| Field | Type | Default | Class | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` | [ResponseKind](#enums) | `"UNKNOWN"` | personal | Shape of the response; SKIPPED when the learner moved on without answering. |
| `choice_ids` | array of string | `[]` | personal | CHOICE: IDs of the options chosen, as named in the item definition. |
| `numeric_value` | double or null | `null` | personal | NUMERIC: the number entered. |
| `unit` | string or null | `null` | personal | NUMERIC: the unit symbol chosen, from the item's list of units. |
| `expression` | string or null | `null` | personal | EXPRESSION: the algebraic answer entered with the maths keypad or answer field, at most 500 characters (checked at ingestion, T025). |
| `order` | array of string | `[]` | personal | ORDER: element IDs in the order the learner gave. |
| `widget_values` | map of double | `{}` | personal | WIDGET: parameter values set in the interactive simulation, by parameter name from the item definition. |

### item.hesitation

The learner stayed idle on an item for more than 3 seconds after it was presented (no gesture, no answer). Emitted when the idle window ends, so its length is known. The app emits none while Kuizi audio plays or a voice command runs (T148), and none while the item is hidden or the app is in the background.

- **Topic** `learner.item.hesitation.v1` · **subject** `learner.item.hesitation.v1-value` · **record** `kuizi.events.ItemHesitation`
- **Owner** data-engineering · **producer** Web and native apps, through the telemetry SDK and ingestion (T024, T025, app event)
- **Envelope fields that must be filled** `client_ts`, `session_id`, `session_seq`, `device`, `app_version`
- **Retention** 7 days in Kafka, 12 months raw in the warehouse · **highest class** personal
- **Example** [`schemas/events/examples/item.hesitation.json`](../../schemas/events/examples/item.hesitation.json)

Consumers (plus the [consumers of every event](#consumers-of-every-event)):

| Service | Tickets | Uses |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Misconception diagnosis | T071 | Hesitation before and between gestures. |
| Knowledge-tracing experiments | T042, T148 | Hesitation as a candidate feature, kept only if it passes the T047 gate including accommodation slices. |
| Learning-analytics warehouse models | T028 | fct_interactions. |

| Field | Type | Default | Class | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `envelope` | [Envelope](#envelope) | required | personal | Shared event context. |
| `item` | [ItemContext](#itemcontext) | required | personal | The item and its presentation_id. |
| `offset_ms` | long | required | personal | Milliseconds between the presentation of the item and the start of the idle window. |
| `idle_ms` | long | required | personal | Length of the idle window in milliseconds; above 3,000 by definition. |
| `before_first_action` | boolean | `false` | personal | True when the learner had not touched the item yet (hesitation before the first gesture). |

### item.interaction

One gesture on an item before the answer: a slider move, a drag, a hover, a focus change or a burst of typing. The app coalesces each gesture into one event (start and end values, duration), never one event per frame. Raw keystrokes, key codes, typed characters and screen-reader commands are never recorded (T024).

- **Topic** `learner.item.interaction.v1` · **subject** `learner.item.interaction.v1-value` · **record** `kuizi.events.ItemInteraction`
- **Owner** data-engineering · **producer** Web and native apps, through the telemetry SDK and ingestion (T024, T025, app event)
- **Envelope fields that must be filled** `client_ts`, `session_id`, `session_seq`, `device`, `app_version`
- **Retention** 3 days in Kafka, 12 months raw in the warehouse · **highest class** personal
- **Example** [`schemas/events/examples/item.interaction.json`](../../schemas/events/examples/item.interaction.json)

Consumers (plus the [consumers of every event](#consumers-of-every-event)):

| Service | Tickets | Uses |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Misconception diagnosis | T071 | Interaction trace (slider values, hovered choices) to explain wrong answers. |
| Learning-analytics warehouse models | T028 | fct_interactions. |

| Field | Type | Default | Class | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `envelope` | [Envelope](#envelope) | required | personal | Shared event context. |
| `item` | [ItemContext](#itemcontext) | required | personal | The item and its presentation_id. |
| `kind` | [InteractionKind](#enums) | `"UNKNOWN"` | personal | Kind of gesture: SLIDER_MOVE and DRAG in simulations and drag-to-order items, HOVER_ENTER and HOVER_EXIT over choices, FOCUS when an element of the item receives focus, KEYSTROKE_BURST for a run of typing in an answer field. |
| `target_id` | string or null | `null` | none | Element of the item the gesture touched, as named in the item definition (for example choice.B or slider.mass). Never text the learner typed. |
| `offset_ms` | long | required | personal | Milliseconds between the presentation of the item and the start of the gesture. |
| `duration_ms` | long or null | `null` | personal | Length of the gesture in milliseconds (drag, slider move, hover, typing burst). |
| `value_from` | double or null | `null` | personal | SLIDER_MOVE and DRAG: numeric value at the start of the gesture, in the widget's own unit. |
| `value_to` | double or null | `null` | personal | SLIDER_MOVE and DRAG: numeric value at the end of the gesture. |
| `sample_count` | int or null | `null` | none | Number of raw input samples coalesced into this event. |
| `key_count` | int or null | `null` | personal | KEYSTROKE_BURST only: how many keys were pressed in the burst, inside an answer field. Which keys were pressed is never recorded. |

An item (question) appeared on the learner's screen. Starts a presentation: every later event about this showing carries its presentation_id.

- **Topic** `learner.item.presented.v1` · **subject** `learner.item.presented.v1-value` · **record** `kuizi.events.ItemPresented`
- **Owner** data-engineering · **producer** Web and native apps, through the telemetry SDK and ingestion (T024, T025, app event)
- **Envelope fields that must be filled** `client_ts`, `session_id`, `session_seq`, `device`, `app_version`

| Service | Tickets | Uses |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Learning-analytics warehouse models | T028 | Exposure per item and abandoned presentations (no item.answered). |
| Misconception diagnosis | T071 | Start of the interaction trace of each presentation. |
| Experimentation framework | T055 | Exposure logging through routing_decision_id. |

Allowed to read the sensitive fields (nobody else may read or store them):

| Service | Tickets | Uses |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Knowledge-tracing training, through the restricted warehouse role | T041, T042, T148, T239, T045 | accommodation.* to normalise time features and to keep abandoned items fair. |
| Champion/challenger gate | T047 | Fairness slices by accommodation type (aggregates only). |

| Field | Type | Default | Class | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `envelope` | [Envelope](#envelope) | required | personal | Shared event context. |
| `item` | [ItemContext](#itemcontext) | required | personal | The item shown and its presentation_id. |
| `accommodation` | [AccommodationContext](#accommodationcontext) or null | `null` | sensitive | Accommodations in force for this showing; null when none or not consented. Sensitive: restricted readers only. |
| `routing_decision_id` | string or null | `null` | pseudonymous | ID of the routing decision that chose the item (routing.decision, T052); null when the item was not chosen by the router. |
| `position` | int or null | `null` | personal | 1-based position of the item in its set, test or session. |
| `time_limit_ms` | long or null | `null` | none | Standard time limit of the item before any accommodation, in milliseconds; null when the item is untimed. The limit that applied to this learner is this value times accommodation.time_multiplier, so it is never stored outside the sensitive record. |

### notification.decided

The Notification Orchestrator (T152) decided what to do with a requested message: send it now, defer it to a digest, or suppress it, and why. Lets T161 prove that nothing non-essential was sent in a protected window and nothing was dropped silently. Carries the copy template, never the message text.

- **Topic** `learner.notification.decided.v1` · **subject** `learner.notification.decided.v1-value` · **record** `kuizi.events.NotificationDecided`
- **Owner** backend · **producer** Notification Orchestrator (T152, server event)
- **Envelope fields that must be filled** none (server event)
- **Retention** 7 days in Kafka, 24 months raw in the warehouse · **highest class** personal
- **Example** [`schemas/events/examples/notification.decided.json`](../../schemas/events/examples/notification.decided.json)

Consumers (plus the [consumers of every event](#consumers-of-every-event)):

| Service | Tickets | Uses |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Notification quality metrics and kill-switch | T161 | Deferrals and suppressions per rule; proof that nothing is dropped silently. |
| Send-time model | T154 | Deferred and suppressed messages. |
| Learning-analytics warehouse models | T028 | Notification funnel. |

| Field | Type | Default | Class | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `envelope` | [Envelope](#envelope) | required | personal | Shared event context; a server event, so client fields are null. focus_session_id is set when a Focus session was in progress. |
| `notification_id` | uuid | required | pseudonymous | ID of the notification, shared by its decided, sent and opened events. Also the orchestrator's idempotency key. |
| `category` | [NotificationCategory](#enums) | `"UNKNOWN"` | personal | Category of the message. |
| `priority` | [PriorityClass](#enums) | `"UNKNOWN"` | none | Priority class (FR-N2). |
| `recipient_role` | [RecipientRole](#enums) | `"UNKNOWN"` | personal | The learner or a parent. |
| `decision` | [NotificationDecision](#enums) | `"UNKNOWN"` | personal | SEND_NOW, DEFER to the next digest or allowed window, or SUPPRESS. |
| `reason` | [NotificationDecisionReason](#enums) | `"UNKNOWN"` | personal | Rule behind the decision (FR-N3, FR-N4, FR-N7, FR-N9): ALLOWED for SEND_NOW, otherwise the protected window, budget, duplicate, opt-out, kill-switch or exam rule that applied. |
| `deferred_until` | timestamp-millis or null | `null` | personal | DEFER only: earliest time the message may go out, in UTC milliseconds. |
| `template_id` | string | required | none | Copy template in the French and Arabic message library (T158). |
| `template_version` | int or null | `null` | none | Version of the copy template. |
| `requester` | string | required | none | Service that asked for the message, for example routing, spaced-repetition, duels or lifecycle. |
| `decision_ms` | int or null | `null` | none | Milliseconds the orchestrator took to decide (NFR-10: under 50 ms). |

### tutor.message

One message in a conversation with the Socratic tutor, from the learner or from the tutor. Metadata only: the text stays in the tutor's conversation store (T069) under its own access and retention rules, and is never copied into telemetry, because a learner's free text can hold personal data that cannot be minimised automatically.

- **Owner** llm-applied-ai · **producer** Socratic tutor service, after the judge (T069, T062, server event)
- **Envelope fields that must be filled** `session_id`
- **Retention** 7 days in Kafka, 24 months raw in the warehouse · **highest class** personal
- **Example** [`schemas/events/examples/tutor.message.json`](../../schemas/events/examples/tutor.message.json)

## Shared records

Defined once in `schemas/events/common/` and inlined into every event that uses them.

### Envelope

Context every learner event carries: who (pseudonymously), when, in which session and on which app. Fields that only an app can know are nullable so server-side producers can leave them empty; the data catalogue lists, per event, which of them must be filled.

| Field | Type | Default | Class | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `event_id` | uuid | required | none | Unique ID of this event, created by the producer when the event happens (UUIDv7 recommended, so IDs sort by time). Retries and offline replays send the same ID again; consumers de-duplicate on it (T024, T025). |
| `student_id` | uuid | required | pseudonymous | Pseudonymous learner ID issued by identity (T012). Never a login, email address, phone number, national ID (CIN) or name. Also the Kafka message key, so each learner's events stay in order within a topic. |
| `tenant_id` | string | required | pseudonymous | Opaque ID of the tenant (school, or the direct-to-consumer tenant) the learner belongs to (E11). |
| `client_ts` | timestamp-millis or null | `null` | personal | When the event happened, by the device clock, in UTC milliseconds since the epoch. Elapsed and lag times are computed from this clock. Null only for events produced by a server without a client request. |
| `server_ts` | timestamp-millis | required | personal | When a Kuizi server received or produced the event, in UTC milliseconds since the epoch: set by ingestion (T025) for app events and by the producing service for server events. Never trusted from a client. |
| `session_id` | uuid or null | `null` | pseudonymous | App session the event belongs to (see session.start and session.end). Null for server events outside a session, such as notification decisions. |
| `session_seq` | int or null | `null` | none | Position of the event in its session, counted by the app from 1. Orders events with equal timestamps and reveals lost events (T029). Null for server events. |
| `focus_session_id` | uuid or null | `null` | pseudonymous | Focus session in progress when the event happened (FR-F6, T155); null outside Focus sessions. |
| `device` | [Device](#device) or null | `null` | personal | Coarse device description; null for server events. |
| `app_version` | string or null | `null` | none | Semantic version of the app build that produced the event, for example 1.4.2; null for server events. |
| `ui_language` | [Language](#enums) | `"UNKNOWN"` | personal | Language of the interface when the event happened. |
| `input_modality` | [InputModality](#enums) | `"UNKNOWN"` | personal | Input channel of the action behind the event (pointer, touch, keyboard, voice, stylus); UNKNOWN for server events. |

### ItemContext

Which item (question) the event is about and which showing of it. Every item-scoped event of one showing carries the same presentation_id, which joins item.presented, item.interaction, item.hesitation, hint.* and item.answered.

| Field | Type | Default | Class | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `item_id` | string | required | none | Item ID in the item bank (T036). |
| `item_version` | int or null | `null` | none | Published version of the item that was shown; null until the item bank versions items (T036). |
| `kc_ids` | array of string | required | none | Knowledge components the item is tagged with, primary first (concept-graph IDs such as mech.newton2, T032). At least one. Tag weights stay in the item bank and are joined by item_id and item_version. |
| `subject_id` | string or null | `null` | none | Subject of the item: physics, maths, sciences, technique or eco_gestion (T033). Null until T033 fills it. |
| `track_id` | string or null | `null` | personal | Bac section the item was served for (T033); personal because it reveals the learner's section. Null until T033 fills it. |
| `item_language` | [Language](#enums) | `"UNKNOWN"` | personal | Language variant of the item that was shown. |
| `presentation_id` | uuid | required | pseudonymous | ID of this showing of the item, created by the app with item.presented. |
| `activity` | [Activity](#enums) | `"UNKNOWN"` | personal | Why the item was shown (practice, placement, review, remediation, assignment, mock Bac, duel). |

### AccommodationContext

Accommodations in force when the event happened, so knowledge tracing never reads extra time or assistive listening as weakness (T148). SENSITIVE health-related data under Law 2004-63 (docs/requirements/accessibility-focus-notifications.md, section 3): filled only when the student has an accommodation and has given the separate accommodation consent (T013, T151); readers are restricted to those listed in the data catalogue. The field holding this record is null otherwise, and models treat null as standard conditions.

| Field | Type | Default | Class | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `time_multiplier` | double | `1.0` | sensitive | Time multiplier applied to this item's timers and hint timers for this event (1.0, 1.33 or 1.5; FR-A14, T145), whether or not the school has attested it yet. Knowledge tracing uses it to normalise time features (T148). |
| `untimed` | boolean | `false` | sensitive | True when the accommodation removes time limits altogether; time_multiplier is then ignored. |
| `assistive_modes` | array of [AssistiveMode](#enums) | `[]` | sensitive | Assistive technologies in use (screen reader, magnifier, switch access, voice control). Empty when none. Feeds the assistive-mode embedding (T148). |

### Device

Coarse description of the device. Deliberately minimal: no device or advertising identifier, user-agent string, IP address, model name, screen size or location, so a device cannot be fingerprinted from telemetry.

| Field | Type | Default | Class | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `platform` | [Platform](#enums) | `"UNKNOWN"` | personal | App that produced the event: web, iOS or Android. |
| `form_factor` | [FormFactor](#enums) | `"UNKNOWN"` | personal | Phone, tablet or desktop. |

### Enums

| Enum | Symbols | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Activity` | `UNKNOWN`, `PRACTICE`, `PLACEMENT`, `REVIEW`, `REMEDIATION`, `ASSIGNMENT`, `MOCK_BAC`, `DUEL` | Why the item was shown: free practice, the placement test (T175), spaced review, a remediation, a teacher assignment, the mock Bac (E18) or a duel. |
| `AssistiveMode` | `UNKNOWN`, `SCREEN_READER`, `SCREEN_MAGNIFIER`, `SWITCH_ACCESS`, `VOICE_CONTROL` | Assistive technology in use, from the comfort profile (T134) and, on native apps, the operating system's accessibility state. Sensitive: it can reveal a disability (Law 2004-63). |
| `FocusEndReason` | `UNKNOWN`, `COMPLETED`, `STOPPED_EARLY`, `INTERRUPTED`, `APP_CLOSED` | Why the Focus session ended. |
| `FocusSource` | `UNKNOWN`, `DAILY_PLAN`, `EXERCISE`, `OS_FOCUS` | Where the Focus session was started. |
| `FormFactor` | `UNKNOWN`, `PHONE`, `TABLET`, `DESKTOP` | Size class of the device, as the app sees it. No model name, screen size or device identifier is ever recorded. |
| `HintSource` | `UNKNOWN`, `ITEM_BANK`, `TUTOR` | Where the hint came from. |
| `HintTrigger` | `UNKNOWN`, `STUDENT`, `TIMER`, `TUTOR` | Who or what asked for the hint. |
| `InputModality` | `UNKNOWN`, `POINTER`, `TOUCH`, `KEYBOARD`, `VOICE`, `STYLUS` | Physical input channel of the action behind the event. Assistive devices report the channel they emulate (a switch that sends key presses is KEYBOARD); the assistive technology itself is only recorded, as sensitive data, in AccommodationContext.assistive_modes. |
| `InteractionKind` | `UNKNOWN`, `SLIDER_MOVE`, `DRAG`, `HOVER_ENTER`, `HOVER_EXIT`, `FOCUS`, `KEYSTROKE_BURST` | Kind of gesture. |
| `JudgeVerdict` | `UNKNOWN`, `NOT_JUDGED`, `PASSED`, `REVISED`, `BLOCKED` | Outcome of the LLM judge for a tutor message. |
| `Language` | `UNKNOWN`, `FR`, `AR` | Language of the interface or of a piece of content: French or Arabic. |
| `NotificationCategory` | `UNKNOWN`, `CONSENT`, `ACCOUNT_SECURITY`, `REVIEW_DUE`, `PLAN_REMINDER`, `DUEL_INVITE`, `PARENT_SUMMARY`, `DIGEST`, `LIFECYCLE` | Category of a notification, as configured in the Notification Orchestrator (T152) and the student's settings (T157). |
| `NotificationChannel` | `UNKNOWN`, `PUSH`, `WEB_PUSH`, `SMS`, `EMAIL`, `IN_APP` | Delivery channel of a notification (FR-N8). |
| `NotificationDecision` | `UNKNOWN`, `SEND_NOW`, `DEFER`, `SUPPRESS` | What the orchestrator decided. |
| `NotificationDecisionReason` | `UNKNOWN`, `ALLOWED`, `QUIET_HOURS`, `CLASS_HOURS`, `FOCUS_SESSION`, `DAILY_BUDGET`, `DUPLICATE`, `OPTED_OUT`, `KILL_SWITCH`, `EXAM_RULE` | Rule that decided. |
| `NotificationSurface` | `UNKNOWN`, `SYSTEM_NOTIFICATION`, `INBOX`, `EMAIL_LINK`, `SMS_LINK` | Where the notification was opened. |
| `Platform` | `UNKNOWN`, `WEB`, `IOS`, `ANDROID` | Which Kuizi app produced the event. UNKNOWN for server-side events and for values an older reader does not know. |
| `PriorityClass` | `UNKNOWN`, `ESSENTIAL`, `USEFUL`, `OPTIONAL` | Priority class of a notification (FR-N2): essential messages are always delivered, useful ones follow the budget and protected windows, optional ones are off by default. |
| `RecipientRole` | `UNKNOWN`, `STUDENT`, `PARENT` | Who receives the notification. Envelope.student_id is always the learner the notification is about, also when a parent receives it; the parent's own identifiers are never recorded. |
| `ResponseKind` | `UNKNOWN`, `CHOICE`, `NUMERIC`, `EXPRESSION`, `ORDER`, `WIDGET`, `SKIPPED` | Shape of the response. |
| `SessionEndReason` | `UNKNOWN`, `USER_EXIT`, `IDLE_TIMEOUT`, `APP_BACKGROUND`, `SIGN_OUT` | Why the session ended. |
| `SessionEntryPoint` | `UNKNOWN`, `DIRECT`, `DAILY_PLAN`, `NOTIFICATION`, `DEEP_LINK`, `ASSIGNMENT` | How the learner arrived. |
| `SpeechContent` | `UNKNOWN`, `ITEM_STEM`, `ITEM_CHOICE`, `HINT`, `TUTOR_MESSAGE`, `FEEDBACK`, `SIMULATION_DESCRIPTION`, `NOTIFICATION`, `OTHER` | What kind of content was read. |
| `SpeechTrigger` | `UNKNOWN`, `USER`, `AUTO` | What started the playback. |
| `TutorInputMethod` | `UNKNOWN`, `TYPED`, `DICTATED`, `MATH_KEYPAD`, `SUGGESTED_PROMPT`, `GENERATED` | How the message was written. |
| `TutorRole` | `UNKNOWN`, `STUDENT`, `TUTOR` | Author of the message. |

## Consumers of every event

| Service | Tickets | Uses |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Warehouse sink | T027, T028 | Every field into the RAW schema, then one dbt staging model per event; sensitive fields land in masked columns. |
| Data-quality monitors | T029 | Volume per event and app version, null rates, duplicate rate on envelope.event_id, client-to-server lag. |
| Data lifecycle (erasure and export) | T018 | Finds every row by envelope.student_id for erasure and the learner's own export. |
| Synthetic data generator (writes, does not read) | T219 | Produces synthetic events of every type, including accommodations, for tests and preview environments. |
